name: single-thread-add-word

name: visible-table-clear-slots-two-through-thirteen-2x2-output

name: linked-single-offset-copy
rationale: One invocation selects the rank-one, one-element path. Zero enabled offset dimensions avoid indirect array access, zero strides address element zero in both direct buffers, and the linked secondary prefix is the exact retained zero-offset implementation. The kernel copies the authored 16-bit input into the poisoned output.

name: vertex-narrow-attributes
rationale: One rasterization-disabled vertex invocation widens authored uchar and ushort2 attributes and writes their exact sum 9 to a poisoned device word.

name: float4-to-half4-varying-conversion

name: constant-float4-red
rationale: The fragment entry ignores its stage inputs and returns literal float4 (1,0,0,1) at color location zero; one full-coverage fragment must replace the complete poisoned pixel.

name: linked-zero-work-ndarray-vector-matrix-multiply-5-8
